notes: One line per edition from the keeper of the Chronicle, saying what the day is in the longer story since 1945, by these headlines. Lines are added, never revised or removed.

lines.line: On 29 October 2026 the Iran war's price rise is read into borrowing costs: the Fed holds, Korean mortgage rates hit a 14-year high, and the UK cuts growth over the war.
On 30 October 2026, days before the US midterms, Washington is reported pressing for lower oil prices in two wars, and US growth of 3.4% is credited to AI.
